fates.map: rename the label; tokens keep their component role
fates.outside: keep the example; label these tokens O
fates.separator: not a source token; render as a line break between fields and label it O

parsing.columns: language TAB country TAB tagged address
parsing.line_ending: lines end in CRLF; strip the trailing carriage return before splitting the last token, or the last label reads 'country\r'
parsing.token_split: tokens are separated by single spaces; split each token on its last '/', because a literal slash token appears as '//house_number'
parsing.fsep: '|/FSEP' is inserted by formatter.py where the rendered template had a line break (splitter ' | ', field_separator_tag 'FSEP'); it is not text that appeared in the address
parsing.sep: '<punct>/SEP' is a literal separator token (comma, hyphen, semicolon) between components; formatter.py tags template separators with separator_tag 'SEP'
parsing.observed: label counts from the first 200000 lines of each of the six 20170304 files, 2026-09-22: every README label occurs except attention and care_of; SEP and FSEP occur in every file

staircase.reason: sub-building locator; too rare for its own label; not misleading as unit

entrance.reason: sub-building locator; same reasoning as staircase

city_district.reason: public taxonomy has one district level

island.reason: sits between city and country in postal hierarchies; administrative region in the starting countries

state_district.reason: public taxonomy has one district level

state.reason: first-level administrative division; the README notes England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland are tagged state

country_region.reason: informal subdivision of a country per the README; country is reserved for the sovereign state

house.reason: venue or building names are org or place entities; the spec says the outer entity wins and the address taxonomy has no venue label

world_region.reason: supra-national context such as 'West Indies', not a deliverable address component

attention.upstream: defined in formatter.py, not in the README, not observed in the sampled lines
attention.reason: an 'Attn: Jane Doe' line is a person entity next to the address, not a component; the spec's taxonomy has no attention label

care_of.upstream: defined in formatter.py, not in the README, not observed in the sampled lines
care_of.reason: a 'c/o' line names a person or org, which the spec makes a separate entity

SEP.upstream: separator tag from formatter.py, not a README label
SEP.reason: literal punctuation between components; it belongs to no component

category.reason: search-query generator output, not an address

near.reason: search-query generator output, not an address

FSEP.upstream: field separator tag from formatter.py, not a README label
FSEP.reason: stands for a line break in the rendered address; keeping '|' as text would teach the model a character that never appears in real addresses
